s: Ardvi Sura Anahita has a thousand cells and a thousand channels
q: when she runs down there, when she streams down there, she, Ardvi Sûra Anâhita, who has a thousand cells and a thousand channels;

s: Ardvi Sura Anahita flows from Hukairya (down to the sea Vouru-Kasha)
q: that runs powerfully from the height Hukairya down to the sea Vouru-Kasha.

s: Spenta-Mainyu maintains the sky
q: Spenta-Mainyu maintained the sky, and they sustained it from below, they, the strong Fravashis, who sit in silence, gazing with sharp looks;

s: Spenta-Mainyu fixes the sky
q: when Spenta-Mainyu fixed the sky, when he fixed the waters, when the earth, when the cattle, when the plants, when the child conceived in the womb,

s: Ahura Mazda maintains the sky (through the brightness and glory of the Fravashis of the faithful)
q: 'Through their brightness and glory, O Zarathustra! I maintain that sky, there above, shining and seen afar, and encompassing this earth all around.

s: Spenta-Mainyu maintains the sky (with support from the Fravashis of the faithful)
q: Spenta-Mainyu maintained the sky, and they sustained it from below, they, the strong Fravashis, who sit in silence, gazing with sharp looks;

s: Daêvas are opposed to Fravashis of the faithful (as enemies in battle)
q: who gallantly and bravely fight, causing havoc, wounding, breaking to pieces all the malice of the malicious, Daêvas and men, and smiting powerfully in battle, at their wish and will.

s: Daêvas oppress the stars (before the stars begin moving again)
q: who showed their paths to the stars, the moon, the sun, and the endless lights, that had stood before for a long time in the same place, without moving forwards, through the oppression of the Daêvas and the assaults of the Daêvas.

s: the Drug has dominion over the material world
q: strength would belong to the Drug, the dominion would belong to the Drug, the material world would belong to the Drug.

s: the Drug has the material world
q: strength would belong to the Drug, the dominion would belong to the Drug, the material world would belong to the Drug.

s: the material world is a bodily world (containing the living and the dead)
q: the wide earth made by Ahura, the large and broad earth, that bears so much that is fine, that bears all the bodily world, the live and the dead, and the high mountains, rich in pastures and waters;

s: the sky is a heavenly structure (shining and encompassing the earth)
q: It looks like a palace, that stands built of a heavenly substance, firmly established, with ends that lie afar, shining in its body of ruby over the three-thirds (of the earth);

s: the sky is maintained by Fravashis of the faithful (through their brightness and glory)
q: Through their brightness and glory, O Zarathustra! I maintain that sky, there above, shining and seen afar, and encompassing this earth all around.

s: earth bears all the bodily world (the live and the dead, and the high mountains)
q: the large and broad earth, that bears so much that is fine, that bears all the bodily world, the live and the dead, and the high mountains, rich in pastures and waters;

s: the sea Vouru-Kasha is a sea (whose shores and middle boil when Ardvi Sura Anahita flows into it)
q: All the shores of the sea Vouru-Kasha are boiling over, all the middle of it is boiling over, when she runs down there, when she streams down there, she, Ardvi Sûra Anâhita, who has a thousand cells and a thousand channels;

s: Ahura Mazda maintains Ardvi Sura Anahita (through the brightness and glory of the Fravashis of the faithful)
q: 'Through their brightness and glory, O Zarathustra! I maintain Ardvi Sara Anâhita, the wide-expanding and health-giving, who hates the Daêvas and obeys the laws of Ahura, who is worthy of sacrifice in the material world, worthy of prayer in the material world; the life-increasing and holy, the flocks-increasing and holy, the fold-increasing and holy, the wealth-increasing and holy, the country-increasing and holy;

s: Waters flow from Ardvi Sura Anahita (across the seven Karshvares)
q: From this river of mine alone flow all the waters that spread all over the seven Karshvares;

s: plants grow from earth (by the never-failing springs)
q: through their brightness and glory the plants grow up from the earth, by the never-failing springs;

s: sacrifice is a act of worship (offered to the Fravashis of the faithful)
q: We worship the good, strong, beneficent Fravashis of the faithful;

s: the struggle against evil is a battle (against Daêvas and malicious men)
q: who gallantly and bravely fight, causing havoc, wounding, breaking to pieces all the malice of the malicious, Daêvas and men, and smiting powerfully in battle, at their wish and will.

s: Ahura Mazda makes earth (wide and broad)
q: 'Through their brightness and glory, O Zarathustra! I maintain the wide earth made by Ahura, the large and broad earth, that bears so much that is fine, that bears all the bodily world, the live and the dead, and the high mountains, rich in pastures and waters;

s: Ahura Mazda makes Waters (through the Fravashis of the faithful)
q: Mazda invoked them for help, when he fixed the sky and the waters and the earth and the plants;

s: Ahura Mazda makes the Victory made by Ahura (a victory)
q: You kindly deliver the Victory made by Ahura, and the crushing Ascendant, most beneficently, to those countries where you, the good ones, unharmed and rejoiced, unoppressed and unoffended, have been held worthy of sacrifice and prayer, and proceed the way of your wish.

s: Zarathustra is a Zarathustra (pure and holy)
q: Ahura Mazda spake unto Spitama Zarathustra, saying: 'Do thou proclaim, O pure Zarathustra!

s: Zarathustra worships Fravashis of the faithful (with sacrifice and words of propitiation)
q: Who give good glory to him who worships them with a sacrifice, as that man did worship them, the holy Zarathustra, the chief of the material world, the head of the two-footed race, in whatever struggle he had to enter, in whatever distress he did fear;

s: awful kingly Glory, made by Mazda is a kingly Glory (awful)
q: We sacrifice unto the awful kingly Glory, made by Mazda

s: the Drug is driven before holy religion
q: Who, driving the Drug before him, sought wide room for the holy religion

s: Hunus possess holy religion (standing bound)
q: Who took her, standing bound, from the hands of the Hunus

s: holy religion is established in living world (in the middle, high ruling, never falling back)
q: and established her to sit in the middle [of the world], high ruling, never falling back

s: holy religion is nourished with cattle (plenty)
q: nourished with plenty of cattle and pastures

s: holy religion is blessed with pastures (plenty)
q: blessed with plenty of cattle and pastures

s: Vîstâspa conquers Tãthravant (enemy of the evil law)
q: The valiant king Vîstâspa conquered all enemies, Tãthravant of the evil law

s: Peshana worships Daêvas
q: Peshana, the worshipper of the Daêvas

s: Vîstâspa conquers Peshana (enemy)
q: The valiant king Vîstâspa conquered all enemies, Tãthravant of the evil law, Peshana

s: awful kingly Glory, made by Mazda is made by Ahura Mazda
q: We sacrifice unto the awful kingly Glory, made by Mazda

s: Vîstâspa conquers Aregat-aspa (enemy)
q: The valiant king Vîstâspa conquered all enemies, Tãthravant of the evil law, Peshana, the worshipper of the Daêvas, and the fiendish wicked Aregat-aspa

s: SAOSHYANT is a restorer of the world (victorious)
q: That will cleave unto the victorious Saoshyant and his helpers, when he shall restore the world

s: the good restoration of the world is a restoration (performed by Saoshyant)
q: when he shall restore the world

s: living world is restored by SAOSHYANT (at its wish)
q: and the world will be restored at its wish

s: living world is a ever-living creation (never growing old or dying, never decaying or rotting, ever increasing and master of its wish)
q: which will (thenceforth) never grow old and never die, never decaying and never rotting, ever living and ever increasing, and master of its wish

s: life comes with immortality (during the restoration of the world)
q: when life and immortality will come

s: awful kingly Glory, made by Mazda cleaves to Vîstâspa (in accordance with the Law)
q: That clave unto king Vîstâspa, so that he thought according to the Law, spake according to the Law, and did according to the Law

s: immortality comes with life (during the restoration of the world)
q: when life and immortality will come

s: the creation becomes deathless (prosperous and belonging to the Good Spirit)
q: When the creation will grow deathless,—the prosperous creation of the Good Spirit

s: the creation belongs to Good Spirit (prosperous creation)
q: the prosperous creation of the Good Spirit

s: the Drug has hundredfold brood (evil offspring)
q: she and her hundredfold brood shall perish

s: ASTVAT-ERETA rises from Lake Kãsava (future savior)
q: When Astvat-ereta shall rise up from Lake Kãsava

s: ASTVAT-ERETA is a friend of Ahura Mazda
q: a friend of Ahura Mazda, a son of Vîspa-taurvairi, knowing the victorious knowledge

s: ASTVAT-ERETA is a son of Vîspa-taurvairi
q: a friend of Ahura Mazda, a son of Vîspa-taurvairi, knowing the victorious knowledge

s: ASTVAT-ERETA knows victorious knowledge
q: knowing the victorious knowledge

s: Lake Kãsava is the source of ASTVAT-ERETA (place from which he rises)
q: When Astvat-ereta shall rise up from Lake Kãsava

s: Vîstâspa is a king (valiant)
q: The valiant king Vîstâspa conquered all enemies

s: Vîspa-taurvairi is parent of ASTVAT-ERETA (father)
q: a son of Vîspa-taurvairi

s: Thraêtaona bears awful kingly Glory, made by Mazda (when Azi Dahâka is killed)
q: It was that Glory that Thraêtaona bore with him when Azi Dahâka was killed

s: Frangrasyan is a Turanian
q: That Frangrasyan, the Turanian, bore when Drvau was killed

s: Husravah bears awful kingly Glory, made by Mazda (when Frangrasyan is killed)
q: That king Husravah bore when Frangrasyan, the Turanian, was killed

s: Vîstâspa bears awful kingly Glory, made by Mazda (while maintaining Holiness against the fiends)
q: That king Vîstâspa bore, when he victoriously maintained Holiness against the host of the fiends

s: Vîstâspa maintains Holiness (victoriously against the host of the fiends)
q: That king Vîstâspa bore, when he victoriously maintained Holiness against the host of the fiends

s: ASTVAT-ERETA looks upon Paêsis (with the eye of intelligence)
q: He, with the eye of intelligence, shall look down upon all the creatures of the Paêsis

s: ASTVAT-ERETA delivers to immortality living creatures (by his look of plenty)
q: his look shall deliver to immortality the whole of the living creatures

s: Vîstâspa supports law of Ahura (as its arm and support)
q: who made himself the arm and support of this law of Ahura, of this law of Zarathustra

s: Aêshma flees before ASTVAT-ERETA
q: Before them shall Aêshma of the wounding spear, who has no Glory, bow and flee

s: Aêshma smite the Drug (the most wicked Drug of evil seed)
q: he shall smite the most wicked Drug, her of the evil seed, born of darkness

s: Angra Mainyu is a evil-doing being (powerless after fleeing)
q: The evil-doing Angra Mainyu bows and flees, becoming powerless

s: Vîstâspa supports holy religion (by driving the Drug before him)
q: who, driving the Drug before him, made wide room for the holy religion

s: Mount Ushi-darena is a seat of holy happiness (made by Mazda)
q: the strength and vigour of Mount Ushi-darena, made by Mazda, the seat of holy happiness

s: Mount Ushi-darena is made by Ahura Mazda
q: Mount Ushi-darena, made by Mazda

s: Yathâ ahû vairyô is a prayer (affirming the law of holiness)
q: Yathâ ahû vairyô: The will of the Lord is the law of holiness

s: Holiness is a best of all good
q: Ashem Vohû: Holiness is the best of all good

s: sacrifice is offered for awful kingly Glory, made by Mazda (for its brightness and glory)
q: For its brightness and glory, I will offer it a sacrifice

s: holy religion is a religion (holy)
q: made wide room for the holy religion

s: Zarathustra has law of Ahura (as his law)
q: of this law of Ahura, of this law of Zarathustra

s: the Drug is driven before holy religion
q: Who, driving the Drug before him, sought wide room for the holy religion

s: XX. Vanant Yast is a Yast
q: XX. Vanant Yast.

s: Angra Mainyu is a most abominable
q: I will sacrifice unto Vanant, strong, invoked by his own name, healing, in order to withstand the accursed and most foul Khrafstras of the most abominable Angra Mainyu.

s: Ashem Vohû is a Holiness (the best of all good)
q: Ashem Vohû: Holiness is the best of all good . . . .

s: Yathâ ahû vairyô is a law of holiness (the will of the Lord)
q: Yathâ ahû vairyô: The will of the Lord is the law of holiness . . . .

s: Ahura Mazda made Vanant
q: Unto the star Vanant, made by Mazda,

s: Vanant is a star (made by Ahura Mazda)
q: Unto the star Vanant, made by Mazda,

s: Vanant is a holy
q: We sacrifice unto the star Vanant, made by Mazda, the holy and master of holiness.

s: Vanant is a master of holiness
q: We sacrifice unto the star Vanant, made by Mazda, the holy and master of holiness.

s: Vanant is strong strong
q: I will sacrifice unto Vanant, strong, invoked by his own name, healing, in order to withstand the accursed and most foul Khrafstras of the most abominable Angra Mainyu.

s: Vanant is healing healing
q: I will sacrifice unto Vanant, strong, invoked by his own name, healing, in order to withstand the accursed and most foul Khrafstras of the most abominable Angra Mainyu.

s: Angra Mainyu has Khrafstras (most abominable)
q: I will sacrifice unto Vanant, strong, invoked by his own name, healing, in order to withstand the accursed and most foul Khrafstras of the most abominable Angra Mainyu.

s: Khrafstras is a accursed and most foul
q: I will sacrifice unto Vanant, strong, invoked by his own name, healing, in order to withstand the accursed and most foul Khrafstras of the most abominable Angra Mainyu.

s: Zarathustra is a Spitama
q: Ahura Mazda answered: 'It is the praise of Holiness, O Spitama Zarathustra!

s: praise of Holiness praises cattle (when recited in the fulness of faith and with a devoted heart)
q: he praises the waters, he praises the earth, he praises the cattle, he praises the plants,

s: praise of Holiness praises plants (when recited in the fulness of faith and with a devoted heart)
q: he praises the waters, he praises the earth, he praises the cattle, he praises the plants,

s: good things is made by Ahura Mazda
q: he praises all good things made by Mazda, all the things that are the offspring of the good principle.

s: good things is an offspring of the Good Principle
q: he praises all good things made by Mazda, all the things that are the offspring of the good principle.

s: Ahuna Vairya is a formula
q: For the reciting of that word of truth, O Zarathustra! the pronouncing of that formula, the Ahuna Vairya, increases strength and victory in one's soul and piety.

s: Ahuna Vairya increases Strength (in one's soul)
q: the pronouncing of that formula, the Ahuna Vairya, increases strength and victory in one's soul and piety.

s: Ahuna Vairya increases Victory (in one's soul)
q: the pronouncing of that formula, the Ahuna Vairya, increases strength and victory in one's soul and piety.

s: Ahuna Vairya increases piety (in one's soul)
q: the pronouncing of that formula, the Ahuna Vairya, increases strength and victory in one's soul and piety.

s: praise of Holiness is worth a hundred khshnaothras (when delivered while going to sleep)
q: For that only recital of the praise of Holiness is worth a hundred khshnaothras of the beings of Holiness, when delivered while going to sleep,

s: praise of Holiness is worth a thousand khshnaothras (when delivered after eating)
q: a thousand when delivered after eating,

s: Ahura Mazda is a most beneficent Spirit
q: O Ahura Mazda, most beneficent Spirit, Maker of the material world, thou Holy One!

s: praise of Holiness is worth ten thousand khshnaothras (when delivered during cohabitation)
q: ten thousand when delivered during cohabitation,

s: Haoma is strained for sacrifice
q: that a man delivers while drinking of the Haoma strained for the sacrifice,

s: good thoughts is professed by praise of Holiness (at the same time)
q: at the same time professing good thoughts, good words, and good deeds, and rejecting evil thoughts, evil words, and evil deeds.

s: good words is professed by praise of Holiness (at the same time)
q: at the same time professing good thoughts, good words, and good deeds, and rejecting evil thoughts, evil words, and evil deeds.

s: good deeds is professed by praise of Holiness (at the same time)
q: at the same time professing good thoughts, good words, and good deeds, and rejecting evil thoughts, evil words, and evil deeds.

s: Karshvare Hvaniratha has cattle
q: this Karshvare of ours, Hvaniratha, with its cattle and its chariots, without its men,

s: Karshvare Hvaniratha has chariots
q: this Karshvare of ours, Hvaniratha, with its cattle and its chariots, without its men,

s: Karshvare Hvaniratha lacks men
q: this Karshvare of ours, Hvaniratha, with its cattle and its chariots, without its men,

s: Ahura Mazda is a Maker (of the material world)
q: O Ahura Mazda, most beneficent Spirit, Maker of the material world, thou Holy One!

s: Ahura Mazda is a Holy One
q: O Ahura Mazda, most beneficent Spirit, Maker of the material world, thou Holy One!

s: Ahura Mazda is praised by praise of Holiness (when recited in the fulness of faith and with a devoted heart)
q: He who recites the praise of Holiness, in the fulness of faith and with a devoted heart, praises me, Ahura Mazda;

s: praise of Holiness praises good things (when recited in the fulness of faith and with a devoted heart)
q: he praises all good things made by Mazda, all the things that are the offspring of the good principle.

s: praise of Holiness praises Waters (when recited in the fulness of faith and with a devoted heart)
q: he praises the waters, he praises the earth, he praises the cattle, he praises the plants,

s: praise of Holiness praises earth (when recited in the fulness of faith and with a devoted heart)
q: he praises the waters, he praises the earth, he praises the cattle, he praises the plants,

s: Yast XXII is a text unit
q: Yast XXII.

s: conscience is a maiden (fair, bright, white-armed, strong, tall-formed, high-standing, thick-breasted, beautiful, noble, and glorious)
q: And it seems to him as if his own conscience were advancing to him in that wind, in the shape of a maiden fair, bright, white-armed, strong, tall-formed, high-standing, thick-breasted, beautiful of body, noble, of a glorious seed, of the size of a maid in her fifteenth year, as fair as the fairest things in the world.

s: conscience is soul (the soul's own conscience)
q: And she, being his own conscience, answers him: 'O thou youth of good thoughts, good words, and good deeds, of good religion, I am thy own conscience!

s: conscience reflects good thoughts, good words, and good deeds (as the faithful person's moral character)
q: 'O thou youth of good thoughts, good words, and good deeds, of good religion, I am thy own conscience!

s: conscience is loved by soul (for its greatness, goodness, fairness, sweet-scentedness, victorious strength, and freedom from sorrow)
q: 'And so thou, O youth of good thoughts, good words, and good deeds, of good religion! didst love me for that greatness, goodness, fairness, sweet-scentedness, victorious strength, and freedom from sorrow, in which I appear to thee.

s: soul worships Waters (when seeing derision, idolatry, rejection of the poor, or a shut door)
q: 'When thou wouldst see a man making derision and deeds of idolatry, or rejecting (the poor) and shutting his door, then thou wouldst sit singing the Gâthas and worshipping the good waters and Âtar, the son of Ahura Mazda, and rejoicing the faithful that would come from near or from afar.

s: soul worships Âtar (as the son of Ahura Mazda)
q: 'When thou wouldst see a man making derision and deeds of idolatry, or rejecting (the poor) and shutting his door, then thou wouldst sit singing the Gâthas and worshipping the good waters and Âtar, the son of Ahura Mazda, and rejoicing the faithful that would come from near or from afar.

s: Âtar is a son of Ahura Mazda
q: Âtar, the son of Ahura Mazda

s: soul enters Good-Thought Paradise (at its first step after death)
q: The first step that the soul of the faithful man made, placed him in the Good-Thought Paradise;

s: soul enters Good-Word Paradise (at its second step after death)
q: The second step that the soul of the faithful man made, placed him in the Good-Word Paradise;

s: soul enters Good-Deed Paradise (at its third step after death)
q: The third step that the soul of the faithful man made, placed him in the Good-Deed Paradise;

s: Zarathustra asks Ahura Mazda (about the souls of the faithful and wicked after death)
q: Zarathustra asked Ahura Mazda: 'O Ahura Mazda, most beneficent Spirit, Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! 'When one of the faithful departs this life, where does his soul abide on that night?'

s: soul enters Endless Lights (at its fourth step after death)
q: The fourth step that the soul of the faithful man made, placed him in the Endless Lights.'

s: wicked person's soul abides near wicked person (near the skull on each of the first three nights after death)
q: It rushes and sits near the skull, singing the Kima Gâtha, O holy Zarathustra!

s: wicked person's soul sings Kima Gâtha (on the first, second, and third nights after death)
q: It rushes and sits near the skull, singing the Kima Gâtha, O holy Zarathustra!

s: wicked person's soul tastes suffering (as much as the whole living world can taste, on each of the first three nights)
q: 'On that night his soul tastes as much of suffering as the whole of the living world can taste.'

s: wicked person's soul enters Evil-Thought Hell (at its first step after death)
q: The first step that the soul of the wicked man made laid him in the Evil-Thought Hell;

s: wicked person's soul enters Evil-Word Hell (at its second step after death)
q: The second step that the soul of the wicked man made laid him in the Evil-Word Hell;

s: wicked person's soul enters Evil-Deed Hell (at its third step after death)
q: The third step that the soul of the wicked man made laid him in the Evil-Deed Hell;

s: wicked person's soul enters Endless Darkness (at its fourth step after death)
q: The fourth step that the soul of the wicked man made laid him in the Endless Darkness.

s: Ahura Mazda is a Holy One
q: Ahura Mazda: 'O Ahura Mazda, most beneficent Spirit, Maker of the material world, thou Holy One!

s: Angra Mainyu is a lying one
q: Angra Mainyu, the lying one, said: 'Ask him not what thou askest him

s: wicked person eats poison and poisonous stench (after perishing)
q: 'Let him eat of the food brought unto him, of poison and poisonous stench: this is the food, after he has perished, for the youth of evil thoughts, evil words, evil deeds, evil religion after he has perished;

s: fiendish woman has evil thoughts, evil words, and evil deeds (and evil religion; ill-principled and disobedient to her husband)
q: this is the food for the fiendish woman, rich in evil thoughts, evil words, and evil deeds, evil religion, ill-principled, and disobedient to her husband.

s: Ahura Mazda has Holy Word (as the word to keep, study, and speak forth)
q: 'We worship the memory of Ahura Mazda, to keep the Holy Word. 'We worship the understanding of Ahura Mazda, to study the Holy Word. 'We worship the tongue of Ahura Mazda, to speak forth the Holy Word.

s: Ahura Mazda is a Maker of the material world
q: Ahura Mazda: 'O Ahura Mazda, most beneficent Spirit, Maker of the material world, thou Holy One!

s: Ahura Mazda is a most beneficent Spirit
q: Ahura Mazda: 'O Ahura Mazda, most beneficent Spirit, Maker of the material world, thou Holy One!

s: soul takes its seat near the head
q: It takes its seat near the head, singing the Ustavaiti Gâtha and proclaiming happiness: "Happy is he, happy the man, whoever he be, to whom Ahura Mazda gives the full accomplishment of his wishes!"

s: soul encounters his own conscience
q: And it seems to him as if his own conscience were advancing to him in that wind, in the shape of a maiden fair, bright, white-armed, strong, tall-formed, high-standing, thick-breasted, beautiful of body, noble, of a glorious seed, of the size of a maid in her fifteenth year, as fair as the fairest things in the world.

s: Vîstâspa has warrior (in three sons)
q: In three of them mayest thou be a warrior!

s: Vîstâspa has tiller of the ground (in three sons)
q: In three of them mayest thou be a tiller of the ground!

s: Vîstâspa has son like himself (in one son)
q: And may one be like thyself, O Vîstâspa!

s: Vîstâspa is swift horsed the Sun (like)
q: Mayest thou be swift-horsed, like the Sun!

s: Vîstâspa is resplendent the moon (like)
q: Mayest thou be resplendent, like the moon!

s: Vîstâspa is hot burning Âtar (like)
q: Mayest thou be hot-burning, like fire!

s: Vîstâspa has piercing rays Mithra (like)
q: Mayest thou have piercing rays, like Mithra!

s: Vîstâspa is tall formed and victorious Sraosha (like the devout)
q: Mayest thou be tall-formed and victorious, like the devout Sraosha!

s: Vîstâspa follows law of truth (like Rashnu)
q: Mayest thou follow a law of truth, like Rashnu!

s: Vîstâspa conquers foes (like Verethraghna, made by Ahura)
q: Mayest thou be a conqueror of thy foes, like Verethraghna, made by Ahura!

s: Vîstâspa rules the country
q: And Zarathustra spake unto king Vîstâspa, saying: 'I bless thee, O man! O lord of the country!

s: Vîstâspa has fulness of welfare (like Râma Hvâstra)
q: Mayest thou have fulness of welfare, like Râma Hvâstra!

s: Vîstâspa is freed from sickness and death (like king Husravah)
q: Mayest thou be freed from sickness and death, like king Husravah!

s: blessing goes for the bright, all-happy, blissful abode of the holy Ones (as its destination)
q: Then the blessing goes for the bright, all-happy, blissful abode of the holy Ones.

s: blessing is fulfilled for Vîstâspa (according to its words)
q: May it happen unto thee according to my blessing!

s: Yathâ ahû vairyô is a law of holiness (the will of the Lord)
q: 'Yathâ ahû vairyô: The will of the Lord is the law of holiness . . . .

s: Ashem Vohû is a holiness (the best of all good)
q: 'Ashem Vohû: Holiness is the best of all good . . . .

s: Vîstâspa receives blessing (from Zarathustra)
q: And Zarathustra spake unto king Vîstâspa, saying: 'I bless thee, O man! O lord of the country! with the living of a good life, of an exalted life, of a long life.

s: Vîstâspa has good life (through the blessing)
q: I bless thee, O man! O lord of the country! with the living of a good life, of an exalted life, of a long life.

s: Vîstâspa has exalted life (through the blessing)
q: I bless thee, O man! O lord of the country! with the living of a good life, of an exalted life, of a long life.

s: Vîstâspa has long life (through the blessing)
q: I bless thee, O man! O lord of the country! with the living of a good life, of an exalted life, of a long life.

s: Vîstâspa has sons (born of his own body)
q: May thy men live long! May thy women live long! May sons be born unto thee of thy own body!

s: Vîstâspa has ten sons (as a blessing)
q: May ten sons be born of you!

s: Vîstâspa has Âthravan (in three sons)
q: In three of them mayest thou be an Âthravan!

s: Amesha-Spentas imparts brightness and Glory (to Vîstâspa)
q: May the Amesha-Spentas impart to thee their brightness and glory and plenty!

s: good Law of the worshippers of Mazda is preached to Frashaostra and Gâmâspa
q: The holy Zarathustra preached that law to Frashaostra and Gâmâspa: 'May ye practise holiness and thrive, O young Frashaostra (and Gâmâspa)!'

s: good Law of the worshippers of Mazda protects faithful person
q: the Law of Mazda, who obtains her wishes, who makes the world grow, who listens to the songs and rejoices the faithful man at his wish; who protects the faithful man, who maintains the faithful man;

s: Ashem Vohû is a good (the best of all good)
q: Ashem Vohû: Holiness is the best of all good . . . .

s: Angra Mainyu is full of death (without Glory)
q: Thus said Angra Mainyu, he who has no Glory in him, who is full of death:

s: Garô-nmâna is a Good-Word Paradise (beautifully made and fully adorned)
q: To bliss and Paradise, to the Garô-nmâna of Ahura Mazda, beautifully made and fully adorned

s: Kinvat-bridge is a bridge (powerful and well-kept)
q: Thus the soul of man, in the joy of perfect holiness, walks over the bridge, known afar, the powerful Kinvat-bridge, the well-kept, and kept by virtue.

s: Zarathustra teaches good Law of the worshippers of Mazda (to Vîstâspa and others)
q: Thus said Ahura Mazda unto the holy Zarathustra, and thus again did Zarathustra say unto the young king Vîstâspa: 'Have no bad priests or unfriendly priests; for bad priests or unfriendly priests will bring about much harm, and, though thou wish to sacrifice, it will be to the Amesha-Spentas as if no sacrifice had been offered.

s: soul is a spiritual entity (departing from the body)
q: when his soul goes out of his body through the will of fate

s: soul is brought amidst plants (At the end of the third night, when the dawn appears)
q: At the end of the third night, O my son, Frashaostra! when the dawn appears, it seems to the soul of the faithful one as if it were brought amidst plants

s: conscience is a maiden (the faithful soul's own conscience)
q: as if his own conscience were advancing to him in that wind, in the shape of a maiden fair, bright, white-armed, strong, tall-formed, high-standing, thick-breasted, beautiful of body, noble, of a glorious seed, of the size of a maid in her fifteenth year, as fair as the fairest things in the world

s: conscience belongs to faithful person (as his own conscience)
q: And she, being his own conscience, answers him:

s: Âtar is a son of Ahura Mazda (valiant warrior)
q: I will worship thee, O Fire, son of Ahura Mazda, who art a valiant warrior.

s: Âtar destroys the Drug (through combat)
q: He falls upon the fiend Kunda, who is drunken without drinking, upon the men of the Drug, the slothful ones, the wicked Daêva-worshippers, who live in sin.

s: Ashem Vohû is a prayer (teaching holiness)
q: Ashem Vohû: Holiness is the best of all good . . . .

s: faithful person has good thoughts, good words, good deeds, and good religion (Every youth)
q: Every youth of good thoughts, good words, good deeds, and good religion;

s: faithful person is protected by good Law of the worshippers of Mazda
q: who protects the faithful man, who maintains the faithful man;

s: faithful person reaches Endless Lights (after four steps)
q: the fourth step that the soul of the faithful man made, placed him in the Endless Light.

s: Zarathustra addresses Vîstâspa (as a young king)
q: Zarathustra addressed him, saying: 'O young king Vîstâspa! May their greatness become manifest as it is called for!

s: priest is like the brightest offspring of thy own blood
q: Thou wilt never offer and give bad food to a priest: for a priest must be to thee like the brightest offspring of thy own blood.'

s: worshippers of Mazda follow good Law of the worshippers of Mazda (as its adherents)
q: Go forward with praises, go forward the way of the good Mazdean law and of all those who walk in her ways, men and women.

s: sacrifice worships Ahura Mazda (as an offering)
q: Ahura Mazda, I worship thee with a sacrifice, I worship and forward thee with a sacrifice, I worship this creation of Ahura Mazda.'

s: sacrifice requires baresma (twigs bound according to rites)
q: Let the faithful man cut off twigs of baresma, either one, or two, or three: let him bind them and tie them up according to the rites, being bound and unbound according to the rites.

s: Good-Word Paradise contains Good Thoughts (as the first destination)
q: The first step that the soul of the faithful man made, placed him in the Good-Thought Paradise;

s: Good-Word Paradise contains Good Words (as the second destination)
q: the second step that the soul of the faithful man made, placed him in the Good-Word Paradise;

s: Good-Word Paradise contains Good Deeds (as the third destination)
q: the third step that the soul of the faithful man made, placed him in the Good-Deed Paradise;

s: Vîstâspa is a young king
q: Zarathustra said: 'O young king Vîstâspa!

s: Vîstâspa has sons ten sons (may be born of thy own body)
q: May ten sons be born of thy own body! three as Âthravans, three as warriors, three as tillers of the ground! May one of them be like Gâmâspa, that he may bless thee with great and ever greater happiness!

s: Ahura Mazda is a maker of the good world
q: 'Proclaim thou that word, as we did proclaim it unto thee! 'O Maker of the good world! Ahura Mazda, I worship thee with a sacrifice, I worship and forward thee with a sacrifice, I worship this creation of Ahura Mazda.'

s: Ahura Mazda is full of Glory
q: Invoke Ahura Mazda, who is full of Glory, Ahura Mazda, and the sovereign Heaven, the boundless Time, and Vayu who works highly.

s: Ahura Mazda protects faithful person
q: the Law of Mazda, who obtains her wishes, who makes the world grow, who listens to the songs and rejoices the faithful man at his wish; who protects the faithful man, who maintains the faithful man;

s: Fravashis of the faithful is a Fravashis
q: We worship the good, strong, beneficent Fravashis of the faithful

s: Fravashis of the faithful fight for the country (in battles fought in their own place and land)
q: They fight in the battles that are fought in their own place and land

s: Fravashis of the faithful look like gallant warrior (girded up and watchful)
q: they look like a gallant warrior who, girded up and watchful, fights for the hoard he has treasured up.

s: Fravashis of the faithful bring waters to kindred (when they win)
q: And those of them who win bring waters to their own kindred, to their own borough, to their own town, to their own country

s: Fravashis of the faithful bring waters to borough (when they win)
q: And those of them who win bring waters to their own kindred, to their own borough, to their own town, to their own country

s: Fravashis of the faithful bring waters to town (when they win)
q: And those of them who win bring waters to their own kindred, to their own borough, to their own town, to their own country

s: Fravashis of the faithful bring waters to the country (when they win)
q: And those of them who win bring waters to their own kindred, to their own borough, to their own town, to their own country

s: Fravashis of the faithful come to help all-powerful sovereign of a country (when invoked and not harmed or offended)
q: And they come to his help, if they have not been hurt by him, if they have been rejoiced by him, if they have not been harmed nor offended, the awful Fravashis of the faithful

s: Fravashis of the faithful serve as weapon (for protection)
q: They come in as a weapon and as a shield

s: Fravashis of the faithful serve as shield (for protection)
q: They come in as a weapon and as a shield, to keep him behind and to keep him in front

s: Fravashis of the faithful are greater than words can express
q: who are greater, who are stronger, who are swifter, who are more powerful, who are more victorious, who are more healing, who are more effective than can be expressed by words

s: Fravashis of the faithful protect against the Drug
q: to keep him behind and to keep him in front, from the Drug unseen

s: Fravashis of the faithful protect against female Varenya fiend
q: from the Drug unseen, from the female Varenya fiend, from the evil-doer bent on mischief, and from that fiend who is all death, Angra Mainyu.

s: Fravashis of the faithful protect against evil-doer bent on mischief
q: from the Drug unseen, from the female Varenya fiend, from the evil-doer bent on mischief, and from that fiend who is all death, Angra Mainyu.

s: Fravashis of the faithful protect against Angra Mainyu
q: from the Drug unseen, from the female Varenya fiend, from the evil-doer bent on mischief, and from that fiend who is all death, Angra Mainyu.

s: Fravashis of the faithful are like well-winged birds (in their flight to help)
q: they come flying unto him, it seems as if they were well-winged birds.

s: Fravashis of the faithful protect against sword (well-thrust)
q: So that neither the sword well-thrust, neither the club well-falling, nor the arrow well-shot, nor the spear well-darted, nor the stones flung from the arm shall destroy him.

s: Fravashis of the faithful protect against club (well-falling)
q: So that neither the sword well-thrust, neither the club well-falling, nor the arrow well-shot, nor the spear well-darted, nor the stones flung from the arm shall destroy him.

s: Fravashis of the faithful protect against arrow (well-shot)
q: So that neither the sword well-thrust, neither the club well-falling, nor the arrow well-shot, nor the spear well-darted, nor the stones flung from the arm shall destroy him.

s: Fravashis of the faithful protect against spear (well-darted)
q: So that neither the sword well-thrust, neither the club well-falling, nor the arrow well-shot, nor the spear well-darted, nor the stones flung from the arm shall destroy him.

s: Fravashis of the faithful protect against stones (flung from the arm)
q: So that neither the sword well-thrust, neither the club well-falling, nor the arrow well-shot, nor the spear well-darted, nor the stones flung from the arm shall destroy him.

s: Fravashis of the faithful run into Myazdas (by tens of thousands)
q: who run by tens of thousands into the midst of the Myazdas.

s: Fravashis of the faithful ask for help (continually)
q: They come on this side, they come on that side, never resting, the good, powerful, beneficent Fravashis of the faithful, asking for help thus

s: Fravashis of the faithful seek sacrifice
q: Who will praise us? Who will offer us a sacrifice? Who will meditate upon us? Who will bless us?

s: Fravashis of the faithful receive meat and clothes (with a prayer worthy of bliss)
q: Who will receive us with meat and clothes in his hand and with a prayer worthy of bliss?

s: Fravashis of the faithful are most effective among creatures of the two Spirits
q: They are the most effective amongst the creatures of the two Spirits

s: Fravashis of the faithful stood holding fast when creation of the world
q: who stood holding fast when the two Spirits created the world

s: Angra Mainyu breaks into creation of the world (through the creation of the good holiness)
q: When Angra Mainyu broke into the creation of the good holiness

s: Waters come up from the sea Vouru-Kasha
q: when the waters come up from the sea Vouru-Kasha

s: Fravashis of the faithful destroy Angra Mainyu (with Vohû Manô and Âtar)
q: They destroyed the malice of the fiend Angra Mainyu

s: Waters continue flowing plants (after Angra Mainyu's malice was destroyed)
q: so that the waters did not stop flowing nor did the plants stop growing

s: plants continue growing Waters (after Angra Mainyu's malice was destroyed)
q: so that the waters did not stop flowing nor did the plants stop growing

s: Waters are created by Ahura Mazda (most beneficent waters)
q: but at once the most beneficent waters of the creator and ruler, Ahura Mazda, flowed forward

s: plants are created by Ahura Mazda (his plants)
q: but at once the most beneficent waters of the creator and ruler, Ahura Mazda, flowed forward and his plants went on growing.

s: Ahura Mazda is a creator and ruler
q: the most beneficent waters of the creator and ruler, Ahura Mazda

s: Ahura Mazda has fravashi Fravashi of Ahura Mazda
q: Of all those ancient Fravashis, we worship the Fravashi of Ahura Mazda

s: Fravashi of Ahura Mazda clothes Amesha-Spentas (with beautiful, active forms)
q: we worship the beautiful forms, the active forms wherewith he clothes the Amesha-Spentas

s: Fravashis of the faithful seek water for kindred (for their own kindred)
q: Seeking water for their own kindred, for their own borough, for their own town, for their own country

s: Fravashis of the faithful seek water for borough (for their own borough)
q: Seeking water for their own kindred, for their own borough, for their own town, for their own country

s: Fravashis of the faithful seek water for town (for their own town)
q: Seeking water for their own kindred, for their own borough, for their own town, for their own country

s: Fravashis of the faithful seek water for the country (for their own country)
q: Seeking water for their own kindred, for their own borough, for their own town, for their own country

s: Fravashis of the faithful is a holy beings (good, strong, beneficent)
q: We worship the good, strong, beneficent Fravashis of the Amesha-Spentas, the bright ones, whose looks perform what they wish, the tall, quickly coming to do, strong, and lordly, who are undecaying and holy;

s: Amesha-Spentas thinks of Garô-nmâna (one another's soul thinking of)
q: Who see one another's soul thinking of good thoughts, thinking of good words, thinking of good deeds, thinking of Garô-nmâna, and whose ways are shining as they go down towards the libations.

s: Ahura Mazda is a Maker (father and commander of the Amesha-Spentas)
q: whose father and commander is the same, namely, the Maker, Ahura Mazda;

s: Gaya Maretan is a first listener to the thought and teaching of Ahura Mazda
q: We worship the Fravashi of Gaya Maretan, who first listened unto the thought and teaching of Ahura Mazda;

s: Ahura Mazda formed Aryan nations (through Gaya Maretan)
q: of whom Ahura formed the race of the Aryan nations, the seed of the Aryan nations.

s: Zarathustra is a first thinker of what is good
q: Who first thought what is good, who first spoke what is good, who first did what is good;

s: Zarathustra is a first speaker of what is good
q: Who first thought what is good, who first spoke what is good, who first did what is good;

s: Zarathustra is a first doer of what is good
q: Who first thought what is good, who first spoke what is good, who first did what is good;

s: Zarathustra is a first Priest
q: who was the first Priest, the first Warrior, the first Plougher of the ground;

s: Zarathustra is a first Warrior
q: who was the first Priest, the first Warrior, the first Plougher of the ground;

s: Fravashis of the faithful belongs to Amesha-Spentas
q: We worship the good, strong, beneficent Fravashis of the Amesha-Spentas, the bright ones, whose looks perform what they wish, the tall, quickly coming to do, strong, and lordly, who are undecaying and holy;

s: Zarathustra is a first Plougher of the ground
q: who was the first Priest, the first Warrior, the first Plougher of the ground;

s: Zarathustra first knew the good things made by Mazda
q: who first knew and first taught; who first possessed and first took possession of the Bull, of Holiness, of the Word, the obedience to the Word, and dominion, and all the good things made by Mazda, that are the offspring of the good Principle;

s: Zarathustra first taught the good things made by Mazda
q: who first knew and first taught; who first possessed and first took possession of the Bull, of Holiness, of the Word, the obedience to the Word, and dominion, and all the good things made by Mazda, that are the offspring of the good Principle;

s: Zarathustra possessed Bull (first)
q: who first knew and first taught; who first possessed and first took possession of the Bull, of Holiness, of the Word, the obedience to the Word, and dominion, and all the good things made by Mazda, that are the offspring of the good Principle;

s: Zarathustra possessed Holiness (first)
q: who first knew and first taught; who first possessed and first took possession of the Bull, of Holiness, of the Word, the obedience to the Word, and dominion, and all the good things made by Mazda, that are the offspring of the good Principle;

s: Zarathustra possessed Word (first)
q: who first knew and first taught; who first possessed and first took possession of the Bull, of Holiness, of the Word, the obedience to the Word, and dominion, and all the good things made by Mazda, that are the offspring of the good Principle;

s: Zarathustra possessed dominion (first)
q: who first knew and first taught; who first possessed and first took possession of the Bull, of Holiness, of the Word, the obedience to the Word, and dominion, and all the good things made by Mazda, that are the offspring of the good Principle;

s: Fravashis of the faithful is undecaying undecaying
q: who are undecaying and holy;

s: Zarathustra proclaimed law of Ahura (word that destroys the Daêvas)
q: Who first in the material world said the word that destroys the Daêvas, the law of Ahura; who first in the material world proclaimed the word that destroys the Daêvas, the law of Ahura;
